ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a shift-register-style counter composed of three D flip-flops, with the three flip-flops sharing the Clock at the bottom. The left, middle, and right three flip-flops are respectively labeled D_A/Q_A, D_B/Q_B, D_C/Q_C. It can be seen in the figure that Q_A is connected to D_B, and Q_B is connected to D_C; above there is a feedback logic gate, which combines the signals of Q_B and Q_C and feeds them back to D_A. The output node the problem requires observing is Q_A. Reasoning: The initial reset condition indicates Q_A Q_B Q_C = 000. According to the connection relationship, the next clock satisfies D_B = Q_A, D_C = Q_B, while what is fed back to D_A is the XNOR of Q_B and Q_C, that is, it is 1 when the two are the same and 0 when they are different. The state changes clock by clock are: 000 → 100 → 110 → 011 → 101 → 010 → 001 → 000, then it cycles. Reading Q_A according to each state gives 0, 1, 1, 0, 1, 0, 0, ..., so the counting sequence observed at Q_A is 0110100...

method.method_draft: First describe the image: a 3-stage D flip-flop shift-register-like counter with Q_A connected to D_B, Q_B connected to D_C, and an XNOR feedback from Q_B and Q_C into D_A; the required observed node is Q_A. Use the text condition that all flip-flops initially reset, so start at state Q_A Q_B Q_C = 000. Apply the next-state equations on each clock: from 000 go to 100, then 110, then 011, then 101, then 010, then 001, then back to 000. Reading Q_A at each state gives 0,1,1,0,1,0,0,..., so the count sequence is 0110100...
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是一个由三个 D 触发器组成的移位寄存器式计数器，三个触发器共用底部的 Clock。左、中、右三个触发器分别标为 D_A/Q_A、D_B/Q_B、D_C/Q_C。图中可见 Q_A 连到 D_B，Q_B 连到 D_C；上方有一个反馈逻辑门，把 Q_B 和 Q_C 的信号组合后反馈到 D_A。题目要求观察的输出节点是 Q_A。

推理：初始复位条件表示 Q_A Q_B Q_C = 000。根据连接关系，下一拍满足 D_B = Q_A，D_C = Q_B，而反馈到 D_A 为 Q_B 与 Q_C 的 XNOR，即二者相同时为 1、不同为 0。逐拍状态变化为：000 → 100 → 110 → 011 → 101 → 010 → 001 → 000，然后循环。按每个状态读取 Q_A，得到 0, 1, 1, 0, 1, 0, 0, ...，所以在 Q_A 观察到的计数序列是 0110100...
